from pathlib import Path
import collections,hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
tools=root/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'
data=tools/'p49_terminal_data'
for name in ('scenario_manifest.json','result_schema.json','expected_diff.json','predicates.json','measurement_exemptions.json'):
    b=(data/name).read_bytes()
    obj=json.loads(b)
    h=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()
    print(name+' canonical_sha256='+h)
    if name in ('predicates.json','measurement_exemptions.json'):
        previous=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'show','6601cfc:docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/'+name])
        assert b==previous
manifest=json.loads((data/'scenario_manifest.json').read_bytes())
reg=json.loads((data/'expected_diff.json').read_bytes())
old=collections.Counter()
new=collections.Counter()
for entry in reg['scenarios'].values():
    for delta in entry.get('differences',{}).values():
        old[delta['old']['kind']]+=1
        new[delta['new'].get('rule',delta['new']['kind'])]+=1
print('scenarios='+str(len(manifest['scenarios'])))
print('modes='+json.dumps(dict(collections.Counter(e['mode'] for e in reg['scenarios'].values())),sort_keys=True))
print('old_sources='+json.dumps(dict(old),sort_keys=True))
print('new_sources='+json.dumps(dict(new),sort_keys=True))
part2=root/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part2'
for kind in ('item3','item4'):
    for name in ('raw.json','output.json','context.json'):
        p=part2/('e1-'+kind)/name
        b=p.read_bytes()
        previous=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'show','27fb460:'+str(p.relative_to(root))])
        assert b==previous
        print(str(p.relative_to(root))+' sha256='+hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()+' UNCHANGED')
p=root/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/p49-terminal-batch-design-v1.31-FROZEN.md'
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='73dad3c6f2f30541998a228cfb05f83718cd1273e2948b4d23b13d0941b6079e'
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'diff','--name-only','HEAD','--','tizen-*/scripts/**','ci_triage/**','release-v1.4.0/**','docs/clang-fix-campaign/design.md'],text=True)
assert changed=='',changed
print('production_diff=EMPTY; frozen_design/predicates/exemptions/OBS=UNCHANGED; producers=NOT_RUN')
